title: Olive's Gift for Fig
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds sh, th, ng
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 35-sound stage (sh, th, ng just added).

pages.illustration: Olive the grey owl perched beside a small wooden box on a window box ledge.
Olive the owl with one wing reaching down inside the open wooden box.
Olive the owl holding up a small pale shell from the box.
Olive the owl holding up a thin silver ring from the box, beside the shell.

pages.text: Olive pops them in a bag.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl placing the shell and the ring into a small cloth bag.
Olive the owl holding the small cloth bag out towards Fig the green caterpillar.
Fig the caterpillar holding the small cloth bag, peeking inside at the shell and ring.

pages.text: Fig gets the ring! Fig has fun.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar holding up a shiny little ring from the bag, delighted, Olive the owl watching happily.
